subject: NimbusPay — Incident closure & action register (latency + error spike)
messages:
From: Sophie Duval <sophie.duval@nimbuspay.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Severe latency + 5xx spike during morning traffic window

Hi Markus / team,

We ran into a major degradation this morning between ~08:30-09:10 PT: page load latency for our payment checkout spiked to 12–18s and we saw ~14% 500 errors at peak. This impacted ~27% of sessions. Our telemetry and logs point to long-tail token generation times and falling back to the smaller model variant during retries.

This has a direct revenue impact for us — multiple abandoned checkouts reported. Can you confirm scope, root cause, and immediate mitigations? We need an executive readout today and a written RCA.

Attaching a short incident timeline from our side (attached: nimbus_incident_timeline.csv).

Thanks,
Sophie
Head of Platform
NimbusPay

Attachments: nimbus_incident_timeline.csv (csv)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Duval <sophie.duval@nimbuspay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:30:14Z
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xx spike during morning traffic window

Sophie — thanks for the heads up and the timeline. We saw the same signal in infra.

Immediate notes:
- Our on-call is analyzing traces now; preliminary readout suggests a KV cache miss storm that increased token compute on a subset of serving hosts, causing CPU saturation and a consequential increase in request queuing.
- We have initiated an emergency canary rollback to the last stable model variant and scaled worker groups in the affected AZ.

I am looping in Kimberly (SRE lead) and Karthik (your AE) to coordinate customer comms and mitigation. Grace / Neha — please prepare an exec-facing note for Sophie while we finalize the RCA.

I'll report back with a short incident write-up within 2 hours.

— Markus
VP, Infrastructure & Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sophie Duval <sophie.duval@nimbuspay.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T11:05:22Z
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xx spike during morning traffic window — initial triage + RCA draft attached

Team / Sophie,

Initial triage summary (short):
- Root cause chain: a regression in the request router's cache key normalization combined with a small subset of requests landing on a new model-variant pool. That caused a high rate of KV cache misses (+220%), which amplified token generation work and produced a CPU run queue on 6/24 serving nodes in us-west-2.
- Immediate mitigation taken: canary rollback to stable variant (09:02 PT), horizontal scale + temporary autoscale policy override, and emergency throttling of low-priority batch jobs. Latency returned to baseline by ~09:18 PT.
- Impact: peak 14% 500s, elevated p95/p99 latencies for ~48 minutes of the window.

Attached: nimbuspay_rca_draft_v1.pdf (draft RCA with timeline, logs, and proposed actions). Also attaching a small autoscale policy patch (autoscale_policy_patch.diff) that tightens CPU thresholds and adds a short warmup buffer.

Proposed corrective actions (summary):
1) Roll forward a router normalization fix (engineer: Martin Keller, 48h).
2) Apply autoscale policy patch and increase min worker buffer in prod (owner: Kimberly Park, deploy tomorrow).
3) Add proactive KV cache priming for esp. high-cardinality tokens (owner: Eng-ModelInfra, 2 weeks).
4) Canary gating for new model-variant pools + an automated rollback window (owner: Runtime Release Team, 1 week).
5) Offer NimbusPay an SLA credit + optional dedicated pool while we stabilise (owner: Karthik Iyer, commercial).

As discussed with Markus, I'll finish the RCA and the action register now and link the dashboard for executive review.

Attachments: nimbuspay_rca_draft_v1.pdf (pdf), autoscale_policy_patch.diff (diff)

— Kimberly
Director, SRE
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Duval <sophie.duval@nimbuspay.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T12:00:48Z
Subject: Proposed exec readout & customer note (draft)

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for flagging. Draft for a short readout below — please tell me if you'd like the tone changed. We can do an executive call at 16:00 PT today.

Draft (to NimbusPay execs):
- What happened (in one line): transient routing regression increased cache misses -> CPU saturation on subset of serving hosts -> higher latency and 5xx errors for ~48 minutes.
- What we did: immediate rollback, targeted scaling, autoscale patch applied to reduce recurrence.
- Next steps: completing RCA, router fix delivery in 48h, autoscale + canary rollout finish in 1 week, monitoring and weekly sync for 4 weeks.
- Commercial: one-month service credit applied, option for discounted dedicated pool until stabilised.

If that looks okay I’ll send now and schedule the 16:00 PT readout.

— Grace
Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Duval <sophie.duval@nimbuspay.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T12:20:30Z
Subject: Re: Proposed exec readout & customer note (draft) — commercial options

Sophie — following up on Grace's draft. We can confirm the following commercial offer:
- A one-month service credit applied to March invoices (formal credit note to follow).
- Option to provision a small dedicated inference pool (reserved capacity) at a 25% discounted rate for the first 3 months while the new canary gating and autoscale protections are in place. We can fast-track provisioning in 48h if accepted.

If you want the dedicated pool we’ll queue an SRE fast-track. I’ll prepare the formal commitment and the DocuSign link.

— Karthik
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Duval <sophie.duval@nimbuspay.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Proposed exec readout & customer note (draft)

Thanks — that draft looks fine and appreciated for the rapid response. We accept the one-month credit. We would like the dedicated pool option while the fixes roll out; please send the provisioning estimate and DocuSign.

We also want an executive readout today (16:00 PT) with Redwood execs present (director+). Can you confirm attendees?

— Sophie

Sophie — confirmed for 16:00 PT. Attendees from Redwood: me (Markus Klein), Kimberly Park (SRE lead), Karthik Iyer (AE), and our Head of Product (Neha Kapoor) will join the readout.

Action register (short, owners, due dates):
- Router normalization fix: Martin Keller / Runtime Release Team — target 2028-03-17 23:59 PT.
- Autoscale policy patch applied to prod: Kimberly Park — target 2028-03-16 10:00 PT.
- KV cache priming PoC: Eng-ModelInfra — target 2028-03-29.
- Canary gating improvements & automated rollback window: Runtime Release Team — target 2028-03-22.
- Commercial: Dedicated pool provisioning & credit application: Karthik Iyer — DocuSign sent by 2028-03-16.

I have uploaded the full action register and RCA draft here: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/NimbusPay-Incident-20280315 and the ops dashboard is at https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ops/nimbuspay-incident-20280315. The RCA draft and autoscale patch are attached.

Please confirm acceptance of these actions so we can mark the incident closed in the tracker and move to monitoring and follow-up sprints.

— Markus

Date: 2028-03-18T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: NimbusPay — Incident closure & action register (latency + error spike)

Markus / team — we reviewed the RCA and action register with our ops and exec teams. Thank you for the transparent timeline and for moving quickly.

Confirmed items:
- Accept router fix timeline (03-17) and autoscale patch deployment (03-16).
- Please proceed with dedicated pool provisioning; we expect the formal DocuSign this week.
- We will join weekly synces; first meeting acknowledged for 03-22.

Once the router fix is in and we've seen one full business-week of stable telemetry, we can consider this incident closed on our side. For Redwood: please keep the incident status updated in the action register spreadsheet (commit-list-20280318.csv).

Sincerely,
Sophie
Head of Platform
NimbusPay
